description.text:
Twenty-five reprints of famous cards from every era of the card game, made for its 25th anniversary and released in Japan on 22 October 2021 beside the 25th Anniversary Collection. The picks run from Charizard, Venusaur, Blastoise, Imposter Professor Oak and Birthday Pikachu to Shining Magikarp, Umbreon ☆, Garchomp C LV.X, M Rayquaza-EX and Tapu Lele-GX: popular cards, promos that once took many redemption points, and cards that shaped how the game was played. Each keeps its original layout, with the set's number at the bottom left, confetti holofoil, etching and a red and gold 25th mark, and none may be used at official tournaments.

In Japan each card came alone in a promo pack, given for every four 25th Anniversary Collection packs bought at participating shops and included in some other products. The same set came out in South Korea, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand and Indonesia, and outside Asia these cards became the Classic Collection of Celebrations.
